probe: Check Image string, asset type, ownership, moderation and target experience permissions; test one known authorized image in same UI.
repair: Use correct image content ID or approved local placeholder; preserve sprite crop. Do not guess nearby IDs.
retest: Actual target experience loads image; record observed appearance and permissions.

probe: Measure bounds against a reference part; compare object transforms, export axes, import settings and pivot.
repair: Correct scale and axis once at source; apply transforms only to a staged copy with rig implications checked.
retest: Reimport; compare dimensions, forward direction, normals, collision and attachments.

probe: Inspect contact windows, root travel, play speed, rest poses and evaluated world foot paths.
repair: Match stride to displacement; adjust planted keys or IK and preserve loop seam. Do not simply slow playback.
retest: Sample both feet and root with same speed; inspect loop at gameplay camera.

probe: Capture actual viewport and safe area; inspect absolute rectangles, constraints, layout owner, long text and scroll extents.
repair: Reflow detail to stacked or sheet layout; preserve action target size, focus and content scroll.
retest: Small phone, landscape and long localized strings; all actions reachable.

probe: Trace Activated connection count, pending state, request IDs and server revision; reproduce with two clients.
repair: Guard authoritative mutation with idempotency and revision; clean old connections; do not rely on disabled client button.
retest: Repeated and stale requests produce exactly one intended grant.

probe: Check navmesh, agent radius, path status, waypoint progress, streaming and dynamic obstacles.
repair: Throttle recompute, add timeout and reachable fallback, cancel on target change.
retest: Unreachable target, blocked path, moving target and despawn.

probe: Inspect assembly roots, anchored members, constraint conflicts, network owner, collisions and simulation timestep.
repair: Use one intended owner and compatible constraints; weld visuals, simplify collision.
retest: Two clients, moving assembly, respawn and disconnect.

probe: Inspect error/result, schema migration, session ownership, retries and budget; distinguish nil from load failure.
repair: Fail closed on load error; versioned atomic update with bounded retry; do not overwrite live data with defaults.
retest: Isolated store/mock failure, reconnect, concurrent write, shutdown.

probe: Capture gameplay at attack start, impact, recovery; inspect particle lifetime, rate, size, alpha and occlusion.
repair: Keep one readable focal silhouette, shrink supporting layers, cap emission and clean up.
retest: Several simultaneous effects at low graphics; target remains readable.

probe: Record same device, scene and workload; inspect CPU/GPU, physics, memory, network separately.
repair: Change one measured bottleneck at a time, preserve behavior and compare p95 frame time.
retest: Repeat workload with warmup, compare capture and note variance.

probe: Stop sync; compare source hashes, mapping and edit owner before touching more files.
repair: Recover known staged source, merge specific changes and agree on authoritative owner.
retest: Dry-run mapping and scoped diff before resuming sync.

probe: Read actual class inheritance, member security, thread safety and current official docs.
repair: Select documented member or supported alternative; don't silently catch errors or fabricate methods.
retest: Minimal isolated use in correct client/server/edit context.
